newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu is chairing a meeting of Romanian Supreme Defence Council.
The meeting is discussing how to upgrade army equipment.
* An explosion caused by a gas leak in a coal mine in the Jiu Valley three miners and seriously injured four, Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said. Twelve others were slightly injured.
Ciorbea said a helicopter transported most of the injured to a Timisoara hospital. Rescue teams were still looking for survivors.
A commission was set up to investigate the cause of the blast and families of the deceased were allocated an aid worth five million lei ($700) each.
* The upper parliament house, the Senate, resumed debates in the afternoon and will hold a session to elect the country's ombudsman from four candidates.
* Foreign Minister Adrian Severin started a brief visit to Zagreb and met Croatian President Franjo Tudjman, Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa and his opposite number Mate Granic.
